server.name: tech.zenfin/zenfinance
server.description: Household finance memory, budgets, transactions, and monthly reviews for AI assistants.
server.title: Zenfinance

tech.zenfin/listing.auth: Remote MCP server with per-user OAuth/Supabase authentication and row-level data isolation.
tech.zenfin/listing.data_boundary: Zenfinance stores user-provided household finance records and does not act as a bank, broker, tax preparer, or licensed advisor. It supports organization, budgeting, education, and review workflows under user control.
tech.zenfin/listing.one_liner: A financial brain for families using Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-capable assistant.
tech.zenfin/listing.short_description: Zenfinance gives AI assistants persistent household finance context: shared orgs, transaction capture, categories, budgets, monthly reviews, and correction tools. It is built for couples and families who want to understand where money goes and decide together.
